messages.text: Shop···· My hammer bc04 miner has a faulty lilygo screen it’s now blank
I'll check our triage guide before answering.

Hi, I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed your message to me.

A blank LILYGO screen is usually just the display, not the miner, so let's confirm that first.

1. Leave the unit powered and plugged in as normal, then open its web UI in a browser on the same network (type the miner's IP address, or find it in your router's client list).

Does the web UI load and show the unit hashing? And does the screen stay completely dark, no backlight glow at all, from the moment you power it on?
I could flashing it with the hammer firmware . Yes the miner runs

Good, that narrows it down: the miner itself is healthy and only the display is dark.

A reflash is the right next step before we call it a hardware fault, since a bad display driver after a firmware update can leave the screen blank while the miner keeps hashing.

1. In the web UI, tell me what firmware version it reports (the exact string on the system or settings page).

Once I have that I'll point you at the matching Hammer BC04 image and the full flash procedure (flashing from offset 0x0000, not just the app partition, so the display config gets rewritten too).
